user.title: Add an RGB IR bulb
user.description: Pick the remote type that matches your bulb, give it a name, and choose which IR transmitter should drive it. If you have several Broadlinks or ESPHome blasters, choose the one in the same room as the bulb.

error.transmitter_unavailable: That transmitter is no longer available.

abort.no_emitters: No IR transmitters are configured in Home Assistant. Set up a Broadlink (or ESPHome IR blaster) first, then try again.
